source: 687 Gaining Immortality
target: 687 Immortalitatem adipiscens

source: Lumian raised his eyebrows and returned Hisoka’s gaze with a radiant smile.
target: Lumian supercilia erexit et Hisokae aspectum cum radianti risu reddidit.

source: The two individuals in different scenes exchanged glances through the blurry void, each casting their eyes in opposite directions.
target: Duo homines in diversis scaenis per nebulosum vacuum aspectus inter se commutaverunt, singuli oculos in contrarias partes coniciendo.

source: Reaza, Iveljsta, and the man and woman who had just arrived in Tizamo had clearly seen the people in the other scene.
target: Reaza, Iveljsta, et vir et mulier, qui nuper Tizamo adventaverant, homines in altera scaena clare viderunt.

source: They were astonished and dumbfounded by this incomprehensible, bizarre situation, but they couldn’t interact with each other.
target: Stupefacti et attoniti erant ob hanc incomprehensibilis et mirabilem condicionem, sed inter se communicare non poterant.

source: The gravekeepers in the same scene as Hisoka appeared to be praying, oblivious to the changes in their surroundings or treating them as if nothing unusual had occurred.
target: Custodes sepulchri in eadem scaena ac Hisoka videbantur orare, mutationibus circumstantibus inscii aut ea quasi nihil insolitum factum existimantes.

source: Lumian surveyed the area and vaguely comprehended the situation.
target: Lumian regionem perlustavit et rem vage intellexit.

source: Regardless of how real this place seems, various encounters will mirror reality to different degrees.
target: Quamquam hoc loco quantum verum videatur, varia congressiones realitatem ad diversa modum reflectent.

source: At its core, it remains a dream.
target: In ipsa natura, somnium manet.

source: And under the influence of the black ancient tomb or the cold corpse within, this area has fragmented into multiple dream shards.
target: Et sub influxu nigri sepulchri antiquati aut frigidi cadaveris intus, hic locus in plurima fragmenta somniorum divisus est.

source: Each time a new group arrives, a fresh fragment is generated…
target: Quoties novus coetus advenit, novum fragmentum generatur…

source: If not for Amandina’s or my arrival triggering some abnormality, it would be impossible for people in different scenes to interact.
target: Nisi adventus Amandinae aut meus aliquam anomalieem excitasset, impossibile esset hominibus in diversis scaenis inter se agere.

source: They wouldn’t be able to attack each other, nor could they see, hear, or detect one another’s presence.
target: Non poterant invicem oppugnare, neque videre, audire, aut alterius praesentiam detegere.

source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: This must be why the gravekeepers vanish every time the Dream Festival commences.
target: Id certe est, cur custodes sepulchri, quoties Festival Somniorum incipiat, evanescent.

source: They don’t disappear. They’re simply in different dream fragments from the Dream Festival participants.
target: Non evanescunt. Simpliciter in diversis fragmentis somniorum, disiunctis a participantibus Festivalis Somniorum, versantur.

source: Based on the results of the previous spirit channeling, is this some kind of concealment?
target: Ex eventibus praecedentibus spirituum canalizationis, num haec aliqua forma occultationis sit?

source: But the black ancient tomb hasn’t been unsealed yet…
target: Sed nigrum sepulcrum antiquum nondum patefactum est…

source: As Lumian’s thoughts raced, Amandina’s voice grew increasingly shrill, filled with terror.
target: Dum Lumiani cogitationes currerent, vox Amandinae magis acuta, terrore plena, facta est.

source: “He’s right in front of me! Save me! Save me!”
target: “Stat coram me! Serva me! Serva me!”

source: Lumian stared at Amandina, who was retreating in an attempt to evade the invisible creature, but he couldn’t perceive the figure she described.
target: Lumian Amandinae aspexit, quae recedebat conata effugere creaturam invisibilem, sed illam figuram, quam illa describebat, percipere non potuit.

source: In the brief span of more than ten seconds since Amandina’s panic attack, Lumian had used his Spirit Vision, Weakness Investigation, Luck Observation, and other abilities, but he hadn’t detected anything unusual.
target: In brevi spatio, plus quam decem secundis, ex tempore Amandinae panici, Lumian visione spirituum, inquisitione infirmitatis, observatione fortunae, et aliis facultatibus usus est, sed nihil insolitum detexit.

source: He was on the verge of taking out the Mystery Prying Glasses and the Eye of Truth.
target: Fere erat ut extraheret Specula Perscrutantia Mysterii ac Oculus Veritatis.

source: Lumian reached into his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian manum in sacculum viatoris sui introduxit.

source: Without a rough grasp of the situation, he didn’t know how to rescue Amandina, who had broken down from fright.
target: Non habens claram comprehensionem rei, nesciebat quomodo Amandinam, quae metu defessa erat, servaret.

source: Just as his fingers brushed against the Mystery Prying Glasses, Amandina was suddenly taken aback.
target: Dum digiti eius Specula Perscrutantia Mysterii tetigerunt, Amandina subito consternata est.

source: After a moment, she turned to Lumian and said in bewilderment, “He—he turned and left. He seems to have recognized me…”
target: Post momentum, se ad Lumian vertit et in stupore dixit: “Ille—ille conversus est et discessit. Videtur me agnovisse…”

source: “Recognized you?” Lumian felt compelled to confirm Amandina’s mental state.
target: ‘Agnovit te?’ Lumian sensit se compellatum ad statum mentis Amandinae confirmandum.

source: Amandina replied in confusion, “Yes, he nodded at me and left.”
target: Amandina in confusione respondit: “Ita, mihi annuit et discessit.”

source: Is this why, after the Dream Festival begins, anyone who wishes to approach the black ancient tomb must be guided by someone who has received the boon of the ancient tomb or the corpse?
target: Num hoc est, post initium Festivalis Somniorum, cur quisquis nigrum sepulcrum antiquum appropinquare velit, a duce moderari debeat, qui beneficium sepulchri antiquati aut cadaveris accepit?

source: Robert and Padre Cali likely played the same role in similar scenes, but they don’t belong to the Evernight pathway and lack dream-related abilities, so they didn’t notice…
target: Robertus et Padre Cali verisimiliter idem munus in similibus scaenis egerunt, sed non pertinent ad viam Evernight nec facultates somniorum possident, ideo non animadvertuerunt…

source: Did the people in the other dream fragments also receive the boon of the black ancient tomb or the cold corpse?
target: Etne homines in aliis fragmentis somniorum etiam beneficium sepulchri antiquati aut cadaveris receperunt?

source: Lumian’s heart stirred as he asked Amandina, “Where did he go? Where did that figure go?”
target: Cor Lumiani movit, rogans Amandina: “Quo ivit ille? Quo abiit illa figura?”

source: Amandina’s gaze shifted to the periphery of her surroundings.
target: Amandinae oculi ad extremitates ambitus circumiecti versaverunt.

source: Her eyes widened with lingering fear and excitement.
target: Oculi eius, metu remanente et exsultatione, dilatati sunt.

source: She raised her palm and pointed at the dream fragment where the man and woman were.
target: Manum levavit et ad fragmentum somnii, quo vir et mulier erant, indicavit.

source: He went there.
target: Ille ibi ivit.

source: He’s gone through! He’s gone through!
target: Ille pertransiit! Ille pertransiit!

source: Amandina’s explanation made Lumian and the others feel the black ancient tomb solidifying and becoming heavier.
target: Explicatio Amandinae facit Lumianum et ceteros sentire nigrum sepulcrum antiquum se solidificare et gravius fieri.

source: The entire area shook even more violently.
target: Tota regio etiam vehementius tremebat.

source: Simultaneously, Lumian sensed a familiar burning sensation on his left chest, but he didn’t hear any ravings that seemed to come from an infinite distance.
target: Simul, Lumian in sinistro pectore ignitum sensum notum sensit, sed nullas voces delirantes, quae ex infinito videbantur, audivit.

source: In a daze, he saw a huge aqua-colored vortex, a dim village shrouded in gray fog, and figures within the village.
target: Perturbatus, vidit ingentem vorticem colore aquae, vicum obscurum in nebula grisea velatum, et figuras intra vicum.

source: Shepherd Pierre Berry, who believed in Inevitability, and Lumian’s friend, Azéma Lizier, raised their pale-white arms, as if silently shouting.
target: Pastor Petrus Berry, qui in Inevitabilitate credebat, atque amicus Lumiani, Azéma Lizier, brachia pallide alba levaverunt, quasi silentio exclamantes.

source: Lumian also spotted his semi-subterranean two-story house and Aurore, sitting quietly on the orange roof with her arms crossed.
target: Lumian etiam domum suam semi‐subterraneam duplicem et Aurore, quae in tegmine aurantiaco, brachiis transpositis, quiete sedebat, conspexit.

source: Lumian no longer resisted the illusion.
target: Lumian illusioni non iam resistebat.

source: He roughly understood what was happening.
target: Vage intellexit quid eveniret.

source: As the figure entered other dream fragments, the black ancient tomb’s abnormality intensified.
target: Cum figura in alia fragmenta somniorum ingressa est, anomalitas nigri sepulchri antiquati intensior facta est.

source: It contained the power of the Death domain, “awakening” the Cordu villagers within the seal.
target: Haec continebat potentiam Dominii Mortis, excitans incolas Cordu in sigillo.

source: These villagers were already deceased, with only soul fragments remaining.
target: Hi incolae iam mortui erant, solum fragmenta animarum manentia.

source: Naturally, they would be affected by the power of the Death domain.
target: Naturaliter, potentia Dominii Mortis eos afficit.

source: This realization made Lumian feel pain, sorrow, and bitterness that he hadn’t experienced in a long time.
target: Haec cognitio Lumian dolorem, tristitiam et amaritudinem afferebat, quae diu non expertus erat.

source: He “watched” Aurore, clad in a light-blue dress with thick, long blond hair and light-blue eyes.
target: Lumian conspexit Aurorem, indutam veste caerulea levis, cum crinibus fulvis crassis et longis atque oculis caeruleis.

source: She didn’t attempt to resist the invisible power of death.
target: Ea non conata est resistere invisibili potentiae mortis.

source: “He walked to that woman,” Amandina continued dutifully.
target: “Ille ambulavit ad illam mulierem,” Amandina officiose dixit.

source: That woman? Camus, Rhea, and Lugano turned their attention to the corresponding dream fragment.
target: Illa mulier? Camus, Rhea, et Lugano animos suos ad illud fragmentum somnii converterunt.

source: Having just arrived in Tizamo that night, the lady in the light-colored dress didn’t hear Amandina’s words.
target: Nuper ad Tizamo advecta, hac nocte, mulier in veste leviter colorata verba Amandinae non audivit.

source: She only knew that the patrol team was looking at her.
target: Ea solum sciebat quod turma vigilium eam intueretur.

source: Her spirituality gave her a sense of foreboding.
target: Spiritualitas ei sensum praenuntiationis mali dedit.

source: She hurriedly turned to her companion and asked, “Devajo, do you sense any malice?”
target: Festinanter se ad socium converterit et rogavit: “Devajo, sentisne aliquam malitiam?”

source: The man named Devajo, dressed in a dark gray suit, slowly shook his head and said, “Nothing.”
target: Vir nomine Devajo, in veste griseo obscuro indutus, caput lente movit et dixit: “Nil.”

source: In the dream fragment where Lumian and the others were, Amandina explained in high spirits, “He… The figure… extended his hand! He pressed his hand… on that woman’s head!”
target: In fragmento somnii, in quo Lumian et ceteri erant, Amandina alacriter explicavit: “Ille… figura… manum extendit! Manum in caput illae mulieris premuit!”

source: Just as Amandina finished speaking, Devajo saw his companion, the lady in the light-colored dress, suddenly collapse to her knees.
target: Dum Amandina locutionem finivit, Devajo sociam suam, mulierem in veste leviter colorata, subito ad genua corruit.

source: Her expression was stiff, and her face was abnormally pale-white.
target: Vultus eius rigidus erat, et facies eius admodum pallida apparuit.

source: Ooo!
target: Ooo!

source: In all the dream fragments, an ice-cold wind howled.
target: In omnibus fragmentis somniorum, ventus glacialis ululabat.

source: Lumian “saw” Aurore standing up on the orange roof, her expression dazed as she gazed into the sky, as if sensing something.
target: Lumian Aurorem 'conspexit' stantem in tegmine aurantiaco, vultu stupefacto dum in caelum aspiciebat, quasi aliquid sentiens.

source: She opened her mouth and spoke almost instinctively.
target: Os aperuit et paene instinctu locuta est.

source: Lumian didn’t know the corresponding language, but he had heard something similar before.
target: Lumian linguam eam correspondens nesciebat, sed aliquid simile antea audiverat.

source: It was the language used by Armored Shadow Chen Tu, a language that Franca occasionally uttered a word or two of!
target: Erat lingua usitata a Chen Tu Umbra Armata, qua Franca interdum unum aut duo verbum edebat!

source: Although he couldn’t understand, Lumian vaguely grasped what his sister was talking about, perhaps due to the connection between them at the soul level.
target: Quamquam non potuit intellegere, Lumian vago sensu percepit quid soror eius diceret, fortasse ob nexum inter animas.

source: She muttered to herself, “An immortal blessed my crown, bestowing upon me the gift of eternal life.
target: Murmuravit sibi: “Immortalis mihi coronam benedixit, donans mihi donum vitae aeternae.”

source: In the dream fragment where Devajo was, the light-colored lady’s hat, which had unconsciously fallen to her knees, suddenly flew off.
target: In fragmento somnii, ubi Devajo erat, pileus mulieris in veste leviter colorata, qui inconscius ad genua ceciderat, subito evanuit.

source: On her neck, the backs of her hands, and the surface of her face, pores opened one by one, producing white feathers tainted with faint yellow stains.
target: In collo eius, in dorsis manuum, et in superficie faciei eius, pori unum post unum aperti sunt, efferentes plumas albas leviter flavis maculis tinctas.

source: Devajo observed this scene with a solemn expression.
target: Devajo hanc scenam vultu solemni conspexit.

source: He didn’t attempt to interrupt his companion’s abnormality and instead took a few cautious steps back.
target: Non conatus est intercedere in abnormitate sociae suae, sed potius paucis gradibus cautis retro se recedens.

source: He couldn’t comprehend what was happening.
target: Non potuit intellegere quid accideret.

source: Although he hadn’t sensed any malice directed at him, he prudently distanced himself from the anomaly.
target: Quamquam malitiam ad se directam non sensit, caute ab anomalia se abstulit.

source: The lady in the light-colored dress’s azure eyes had lost focus, appearing abnormally vacant and lifeless.
target: Oculi azurri mulieris in veste leviter colorata lumen amisere, atque insolitè vacui et sine vita apparabantur.

source: In the blink of an eye, the white feathers, tainted with light-yellow oil stains, seemed to possess a consciousness and life of their own.
target: In momento, plumae albae, leviter flavis olei vestigiis tinctae, videbantur propriam conscientiam et vitam habere.

source: They frantically emerged from the gaps in the fabric of the dress.
target: Ex rimae in textu vestis effrenanter emergere videbantur.

source: Within moments, the lady in the light-colored dress was enveloped by white feathers tainted with light-yellow oil stains.
target: In paucis momentis, mulier in veste leviter colorata a plumis albis, leviter flavis olei vestigiis tinctis, complectita est.

source: Her body grew light and gradually floated, becoming increasingly illusory.
target: Corpus eius leve factum est et paulatim levavit, fiens magis magisque illusorium.

source: Her azure eyes fixed on Devajo as she shouted in a hollow and agitated voice, “I’ve become a god! I’ve achieved immortality!”
target: Oculi eius azurri in Devajo fixi erant, dum voce cava et incitata exclamabat: “Deus facta sum! Immortalitatem adeptus sum!”

source: The white-feathered monster hovered above the black ancient tomb, incessantly shouting, “I’ve become a god! I’ve achieved immortality!”
target: Monstrum plumis albis ornatum super nigrum sepulcrum antiquum latitabatur, continuo clamitans: “Deus facta sum! Immortalitatem adeptus sum!”

source: In another dream fragment, Lumian heard Aurore change her words.
target: In alio fragmento somnii, Lumian audivit Aurorem verba mutare.

source: With a fearful expression, she whispered, “Immortal Ascension…”
target: Cum vultu timido, sussurravit: “Ascensus immortalis…”

source: In the next instant, the ethereal monster, covered in white feathers, flew towards the black ancient tomb in the dream fragment.
target: In momento sequenti, monstrum aetherium, plumis albis tectum, volavit versus nigrum sepulcrum antiquum in fragmento somnii.

source: She passed through the stone wall on the tomb’s surface and vanished.
target: Per parietem lapideum in superficie sepulchri transiit et evanuit.

source: Suddenly, the frigid wind ceased, freezing.
target: Subito, ventus glacialis cessavit, congelans.

source: The black ancient tomb shook visibly, and the tomb door, outlined by hair-like cracks, emitted the sound of dull rubbing, as if someone was trying to push it open from within.
target: Nigrum sepulcrum antiquum manifeste tremebat, et ostium sepulchri, fissuris pilorum similes delineatum, sonum fricationis obtusae edebat, quasi aliquis ex intus illud aperire conaretur.

source: Aurore, “in front” of Lumian and the “surrounding” Cordu began to fade, as if erased by an eraser.
target: Aurore, coram Lumiano et circumstantibus Cordu, incipiebat evanescere, quasi ab “erasore” deletus esset.

source: Lumian glanced at the slowly opening tomb door and turned to “Hisoka” Twanaku, who was in another dream fragment.
target: Lumian ostium sepulchri lente aperiens aspexit et ad “Hisoka” Twanaku se convertit, qui in alio fragmento somnii erat.

source: The dream projection wasn’t surprised by the abnormality, nor did he show any fear.
target: Proiectio somnii non mirata est ab anomalia, nec timorem ostendit.

source: Instead, the silent gravekeepers around him rose to their feet.
target: Immo, custodes sepulchri taciti circa eum surrexerunt.

source: Amidst the illusory sound of water, the tomb door of the black ancient tomb opened completely.
target: Inter sonos aquae illusorios, ostium sepulchri nigri antiquati plene aperitum est.

source: Accompanied by this change, all the dream fragments that appeared in the blur seemed to be pulled by an invisible force, fusing together.
target: Hoc mutato, omnia fragmenta somniorum, quae in confusione apparuerunt, videbantur vi invisibili trahentia et confluentes.

source: Devajo, Reaza, Iveljsta, Hisoka Twanaku, and the gravekeepers materialized in front of the black ancient tomb, near Lumian and the others.
target: Devajo, Reaza, Iveljsta, Hisoka Twanaku, et custodes sepulchri apparuerunt coram nigrum sepulcrum antiquum, prope Luminum et ceteros.

source: “Hisoka” Twanaku smiled, as if he had anticipated that one of the outsiders would transform into a “god” and that the ancient tomb’s door would open at this very moment.
target: “Hisoka” Twanaku subridens apparuit, quasi praevidebat unum ex extraneis in “deum” se transformaturum esse et ostium sepulchri antiquati hoc ipso momento aperiendum esse.

source: He retrieved a golden mask from his black robe.
target: Ex veste nigra sua larvam auream extraxit.

source: The mask appeared to be crafted from pure gold, its eyes and face smeared with white and black paint, giving it an unsettling appearance.
target: Larva videbatur ex auro puro confecta esse, oculis et facie eius albis et nigris pictis, quae ei aspectum perturbantem tribuere videbantur.

source: Twanaku donned the golden mask and, unlike the other gravekeepers, didn’t retreat.
target: Twanaku larvam auream induit et, contrarie aliorum custodum, non recedens fuit.

source: Instead, he sprinted towards the black ancient tomb and the open tomb door.
target: Immo, festinanter, ad nigrum sepulcrum antiquum et ostium aperitum, cucurrit.

source: Thud! Thud! Thud!
target: Tum! Tum! Tum!

source: Lumian heard a distinct heartbeat.
target: Lumian audivit pulsationem cordis distinctam.

source: It emanated from within the black ancient tomb.
target: Emanabat ex interioribus nigrī sepulchri antiquī.
